welcome.title: MoRead: the beauty of words
welcome.intro: Give your attention back to the content. Drag in a Markdown file, or click **Open file** at the top left.
welcome.keys: **⌘ / Ctrl + O** opens a document and **⌘ / Ctrl + S** saves it
welcome.views: Switch between Read, Source and Split at the top; double-click empty space at the top to maximise or restore the window
welcome.sample: Open “See the full example” in the sidebar to try tables, math and diagrams
sample.lead: Give your attention back to the content. **MoRead** is a light, offline Markdown reader and editor.
sample.startP: Drag in a Markdown file, or click **Open file** at the top left. Switch between Read, Source and Split at the top; the sidebar builds an outline automatically.
sample.task1: A quiet, comfortable place to read
sample.tip: Press **⌘ / Ctrl + O** to open, **⌘ / Ctrl + S** to save and **⌘ / Ctrl + F** to find.
sample.textP: Here is **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, ==highlight==, H~2~O and x^2^. Emoji like :sparkles: and the abbreviation HTML work too.
sample.footnote: Footnotes appear at the end, a good home for extra notes.
sample.mathP: Inline math $E = mc^2$, and display math:
sample.details: Safe native HTML such as details, tables and marks is supported. Scripts and remote resources in documents never run on their own.
sample.images: Local images are read from the document's folder and can be clicked to enlarge. Remote images are blocked by default; click the link to open them in your browser. Relative Markdown links only reach folders you opened.
sample.end: If you have read this far, start writing.
